name: plan-flow
category: Workflow · Task → plan → progress tracking → archive
description: Turn a non-trivial task into a plan file in a repository's plans/ directory (planing, pending, archive), tick progress as work is verified, report numeric status on request, and archive only when every task and Definition-of-Done item is checked. Directory is the single source of state; gates are enforced by a standard-library Python script.

runtime: Python 3.9+ standard library only, no pip packages
